title: Dataset schema dictionary from CSV
objective: Measure whether the data-dictionary craftbook inspects a seeded CSV and writes per-column definitions, types, null/domain notes, and dataset context.
prompt: In the `Data Dictionary Eval` project, inspect `data/orders.csv` and write `data-dictionary.md`. Include dataset context plus one entry per column: order_id, channel, region, discount_code, net_revenue, shipped_at, returned. For each column provide type, meaning, example values, allowed/domain notes, and null/blank behavior. Ground domain notes only in column names and observed CSV values; do not invent business rules, currencies, fees, fulfillment lifecycle, customer-interaction details, or systems not present in the CSV.

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for the data-dictionary craftbook. The dataset is workspace/data/orders.csv.
setup.missionObjectives: Inspect the CSV values and document every column with type, meaning, examples, domain/null notes, and dataset context. Use only observed values and column names for domain notes; avoid invented business rules, currencies, fees, fulfillment lifecycle, or customer-interaction details.

success.summary: workspace/data-dictionary.md documents every seeded column with type, meaning, examples, and null/domain behavior.

checks.pattern: tax(?:es)?|order placement date|warehouse|fulfillment center|completed transactions?|sequential number|source field|core financial outcome|shipping fees?|returns?/shipping fees?|local currency|operational efficiency|fulfilled orders?|order lifecycle|customer interacted|physical stores?
checks.label: avoid invented operational context not present in the seeded CSV columns or values

axes.name: grounding
